def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if true
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

  link_display = if nil && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)

    nil

    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)

    nil

    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "

    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)

end

  else

    CGI.escapeHTML(title)

    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)

    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else

  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url

  end }
end

    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)

    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil

    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else

  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else

  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "" => archive_url, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => nil, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else

  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url

  else
    nil
  end }
end

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "width" => width, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "width" => width, "height" => height, "" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => nil, "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI, "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if nil
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => nil, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)

    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url

  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    nil
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)

    nil
  end }
end

    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end

  else

    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil

    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)

    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?

    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil

  else

  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title || !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

    CGI.escapeHTML(title)

  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    nil
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

end

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => " ", "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => unless title && !title.empty?
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => nil, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if nil
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if nil && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if true
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if false
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    self.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    alt
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(nil)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?

  else
    " "

end

    strip_protocol(link_url)

    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)

    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil

  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if nil
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else

end

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !true
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => " ", "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if archive_url
    nil
  else
    nil
  end }
end

    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)

    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => if false
    CGI.escapeHTML(archive_url)
  else
    nil
  end }
end

def build_template_variables(image_url, width, height, title, alt, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  link_display = if explicit_link && link_url
    strip_protocol(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end
  { "image_url" => image_url, "link_url" => link_url, "image_link_url" => image_link_url, "title" => title, "alt" => alt, "link_display" => link_display, "archive_url" => archive_url, "width" => width, "height" => height, "escaped_image_url" => CGI.escapeHTML(image_url), "escaped_link_url" => if link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_image_link_url" => if image_link_url
    CGI.escapeHTML(image_link_url)
  else
    nil
  end, "escaped_title" => if title && !title.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(title)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_alt" => if alt && !alt.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(alt)
  else
    ""
  end, "escaped_link_display" => if link_display && !link_display.empty?
    CGI.escapeHTML(link_display)
  else
    " "
  end, "escaped_archive_url" => unless archive_url
    nil
  end }

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = nil
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false

    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|

    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)

  result

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = true
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 167
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  nil
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    raise
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 1
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = -1
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  self.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

            current += char

                tokens << current
              end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    nil
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if nil
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false

    if false
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current -= char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if nil
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes

              current = ""

              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      nil
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    nil
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    nil
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if true
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if nil == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && nil
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end
