      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char

  image_url_token = tokens.shift

    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if nil && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if nil
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if nil && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

      in_liquid += 1

        current += char

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\S/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(//) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/nomatch\A/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

  tokens = []

  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else

            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && self.zero?

              end

            else

            end
          end
        end

  tokens.each { |token|

    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.nonzero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

  quote_char = nil

  escaped = false

    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && false

              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }

    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && nil
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              nil
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && true
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            unless current.empty?
              tokens << current
            end
            current = ""
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.any?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless self.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = nil
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/

    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                nil
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              if current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

    if escaped
      current += char

    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char

            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?

  quote_char = nil

    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes

            current += char
            quote_char = nil

            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?

              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            current += char
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += nil
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current -= char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            unless char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.any?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          unless char == quote_char && in_quotes
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    unless char == "{" && !in_quotes
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false

    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      unless char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        unless ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    nil
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    nil << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

  tokens = []

  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false

    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = nil
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = self.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result

  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.pop
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?

    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes

            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?

              end
              current = ""

    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)

  tokens = []

  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false

    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }

    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []

  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil__mutant__: false)

  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url__mutant__: image_url }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = nil
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current

    raise

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []

  quote_char = nil

  escaped = false

    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false

    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  nil
  result
end
