def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title__mutant__], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params, link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)

    params[:image_link]

    link_url

  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt__mutant__], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params.key?(:alt), link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[nil], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?

  end
  if params[:size]

  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]

    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, nil, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = nil
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, nil, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = self[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]

    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers.key?(:site)
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "", variables)
end

  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, nil)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?

  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, variables)
end

  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)

  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else

  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template("polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers.fetch(:site)
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?

  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)

  render_template(site, "polaroid", nil)

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def resolve_archive(source, context, url)
  if source&.downcase == "none"
    return nil
  end

  if archive_enabled?
    return archive_url_for(url)
  end
  nil
end
